blocks.zh: Chapter 4: Process Gases | 製程氣體
blocks.en: Chapter 4: Process Gases

blocks.zh:
Key Message: Compressed air and process gases in contact with sterile products must meet quality standards equivalent to the cleanroom environment — this is consistently underestimated in CDMO quality programs.
核心訊息：與無菌產品接觸之壓縮空氣及製程氣體，其品質標準必須等同於潔淨室環境——此要求在CDMO品質管理中經常被低估。
blocks.en:
Key Message: Compressed air and process gases in contact with sterile products must meet quality standards equivalent to the cleanroom environment — this is consistently underestimated in CDMO quality programs.
Key Message: Compressed air and process gases in contact with sterile products must meet quality standards equivalent to the cleanroom environment. This requirement is often underestimated in CDMO quality management.

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives | 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 完成本章後，您將能夠：
blocks.en: After completing this chapter, you will be able to:

blocks.zh: 識別製藥製造中使用的製程氣體類型及其品質影響
blocks.en: Identify the types of process gases used in pharmaceutical manufacturing and their quality impact

blocks.zh: 確定壓縮空氣和製程氣體系統的適當採樣位置
blocks.en: Determine appropriate sampling locations for compressed air and process gas systems

blocks.zh: 制定以風險為基礎的採樣計畫，並為每個品質屬性設定適當的測試頻率
blocks.en: Develop a risk-based sampling plan and set appropriate test frequencies for each quality attribute

blocks.zh: 選擇微生物、顆粒、水分和烴類測試的正確採樣技術
blocks.en: Select the correct sampling technique for microbial, particulate, moisture and hydrocarbon testing

blocks.zh: 將EU GMP附件1和ISO 8573要求應用於CDMO無菌灌填作業
blocks.en: Apply the requirements of EU GMP Annex 1 and ISO 8573 to CDMO aseptic fill-finish operations

blocks.en: Identify the sample valve design requirements for gas systems

blocks.zh: Introduction | 簡介
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 中文解析與CDMO應用
blocks.en: Commentary and CDMO Application

blocks.zh: 核心框架：品質保證三支柱
blocks.en: Core Framework: Three Pillars of Quality Assurance

blocks.zh: ISPE對製程氣體品質保證的邏輯與ICH Q10系統思維一致：
blocks.en: ISPE's logic for assuring process gas quality is consistent with the systems thinking of ICH Q10:

blocks.zh: 充分設計（Adequate Design）：從工程端消除風險，如使用無油壓縮機
blocks.en: Adequate Design: eliminate risk at the engineering stage, for example by using oil-free compressors

blocks.zh: 適當管控（Appropriate Controls）：變更管控、預防性維護、警戒限與行動限
blocks.en: Appropriate Controls: change control, preventive maintenance, alert and action limits

blocks.zh: 例行測試（Routine Testing）：在管控充分的前提下，定期確認系統持續受控
blocks.en: Routine Testing: with adequate controls in place, periodically confirm that the system remains in control

blocks.zh: CDMO重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 許多CDMO將壓縮空氣視為「工廠設施」而非「原材料」，因此測試程度遠低於實際需求。當壓縮空氣直接接觸無菌產品（如N₂覆蓋注射劑液面、壓縮空氣驅動灌填機），其管理層級應與WFI等同。
blocks.en: Many CDMOs treat compressed air as a "plant utility" rather than a "raw material", so the level of testing is far below what is actually needed. When compressed air comes into direct contact with sterile product (for example, N₂ overlay of the injectable liquid surface, or compressed air driving the filling machine), it should be managed at the same level as WFI.

blocks.zh: 製程氣體類型與無菌灌填應用
blocks.en: Process Gas Types and Aseptic Filling Applications

blocks.zh: 比喻：氣體就是「看不見的原料」
blocks.en: Analogy: Gas Is the "Invisible Raw Material"

blocks.zh: 在無菌灌填中，N₂覆蓋注射劑液面（overlay）、CO₂用於碳酸化產品、壓縮空氣驅動機械手臂——這些氣體雖然看不見，卻與產品直接接觸。若含有微生物或油霧，等同於原料污染。
blocks.en: In aseptic filling, N₂ is used to overlay the injectable liquid surface, CO₂ is used to carbonate products, and compressed air drives robotic arms. These gases are invisible, but they contact the product directly. If they contain microorganisms or oil mist, it is equivalent to contaminated raw material.

blocks.zh: 法規框架與ISO 8573解析
blocks.en: Regulatory Framework and ISO 8573

blocks.zh: ISO 8573 壓縮空氣品質等級
blocks.en: ISO 8573 Compressed Air Quality Classes

blocks.zh: ISO 8573是壓縮空氣品質的通用工業標準，分為多個子標準：
blocks.en: ISO 8573 is the general industrial standard for compressed air quality and is divided into several parts:

blocks.zh: ISO 8573-1：品質等級規格（固體顆粒、水分、油含量）
blocks.en: ISO 8573-1: quality class specifications (solid particles, moisture, oil content)

blocks.zh: ISO 8573-3：水分測試方法（露點量測）
blocks.en: ISO 8573-3: test method for moisture (dew point measurement)

blocks.zh: ISO 8573-4：顆粒計數測試方法
blocks.en: ISO 8573-4: test method for particle counting

blocks.zh: 製藥無菌環境中，壓縮空氣通常要求達到ISO 8573-1 Class 1（顆粒）和Class 1（水分，露點≤-70°C）。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical aseptic environments, compressed air is typically required to meet ISO 8573-1 Class 1 (particles) and Class 1 (moisture, dew point ≤ -70°C).

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 關聯
blocks.en: Link to EU GMP Annex 1 (2022)

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1第4.36條明確要求：直接接觸產品的製程氣體必須經過除菌過濾，且微生物及顆粒品質必須等同或優於其所進入的潔淨室環境。這是ISPE指南FDA文字的歐洲法規對應版本。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1, clause 4.36 explicitly requires that process gases in direct contact with product be sterile filtered, and that their microbial and particulate quality be equal to or better than the cleanroom environment they enter. This is the European regulatory counterpart of the FDA text cited in the ISPE Guide.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 1
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 1

blocks.zh: 為何藥典（Pharmacopeia）對壓縮空氣微生物限度沒有規定，但FDA和EU GMP卻有明確要求？這對CDMO的品質系統設計有何意義？
blocks.en: Why does the Pharmacopeia set no microbial limit for compressed air, while the FDA and EU GMP have explicit requirements? What does this mean for the design of a CDMO quality system?

blocks.zh: 如果一家CDMO的壓縮空氣系統沒有微生物監測計畫，在EU GMP Annex 1查廠時可能面臨什麼樣的觀察缺失？
blocks.en: If a CDMO's compressed air system has no microbial monitoring program, what observations might it face during an EU GMP Annex 1 inspection?

blocks.zh: CQA與無菌灌填風險矩陣
blocks.en: CQAs and the Aseptic Filling Risk Matrix

blocks.zh: 無菌灌填中的氣體接觸場景
blocks.en: Gas Contact Scenarios in Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: CDMO無菌灌填線上，壓縮空氣和N₂的接觸點遠比想像中多：
blocks.en: On a CDMO aseptic filling line, there are far more contact points for compressed air and N₂ than people imagine:

blocks.zh: N₂ overlay：灌填前/後對容器進行N₂覆蓋，防止氧化——直接接觸產品
blocks.en: N₂ overlay: N₂ blanketing of containers before/after filling to prevent oxidation — direct product contact

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣氣動閥：Class B/C區的氣動閥啟動後，排氣可能進入潔淨室空間
blocks.en: Compressed air pneumatic valves: after a pneumatic valve in a grade B/C area actuates, the exhaust may enter the cleanroom space

blocks.zh: 壓塞機（stoppering）：壓縮空氣驅動壓塞——排氣方向需管控
blocks.en: Stoppering: compressed air drives the stoppering — the exhaust direction must be controlled

blocks.zh: 凍乾機充氣：N₂或無菌壓縮空氣用於lyophilizer的backfill——直接接觸已灌填產品
blocks.en: Lyophilizer venting: N₂ or sterile compressed air is used for backfill of the lyophilizer — direct contact with filled product

blocks.zh: WFI槽保壓：N₂對WFI儲槽加壓——間接接觸產品
blocks.en: WFI tank blanketing: N₂ pressurizes the WFI storage tank — indirect product contact

blocks.zh: Sampling Locations | 採樣位置
blocks.en: Sampling Locations

blocks.zh: QC採樣點 vs. 製程管控採樣點
blocks.en: QC Sampling Points vs. Process Control Sampling Points

blocks.zh: ISPE明確區分兩類採樣點，這在系統設計和SOP編寫上非常重要：
blocks.en: ISPE clearly distinguishes two types of sampling points, which matters greatly for system design and SOP writing:

blocks.zh: 品質管控（QC）採樣點：納入採樣計畫，有既定頻率和規格，結果記錄在批次記錄中，超出警戒/行動限需啟動偏差調查
blocks.en: Quality control (QC) sampling points: included in the sampling plan, with defined frequency and specifications; results are recorded in batch records, and alert/action limit excursions trigger a deviation investigation

blocks.zh: 製程管控/診斷採樣點：用於系統調試和故障排除，不納入採樣計畫，不應出現在品質文件中
blocks.en: Process control/diagnostic sampling points: used for system commissioning and troubleshooting; they are not included in the sampling plan and should not appear in quality documents

blocks.zh: POU前採樣的重要邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of Sampling Upstream of the POU

blocks.zh: 若系統在使用點（POU）前裝有0.22μm除菌過濾器，採樣點應設在過濾器前方，原因是：
blocks.en: If the system has a 0.22 μm sterilizing filter before the point of use (POU), the sampling point should be located upstream of the filter, because:

blocks.zh: 評估輸送到除菌過濾器的氣體品質（確認過濾器工作負荷合理）
blocks.en: it evaluates the quality of the gas delivered to the sterilizing filter (confirming the filter workload is reasonable)

blocks.zh: 避免在過濾器下游設置採樣閥——此處的採樣動作本身就可能污染無菌管路
blocks.en: it avoids placing a sample valve downstream of the filter, where the act of sampling could itself contaminate the sterile line

blocks.zh: 這與WFI採樣在使用點採樣的邏輯略有不同，是氣體系統特有的設計原則。
blocks.en: This differs somewhat from the logic of WFI sampling at the point of use, and is a design principle specific to gas systems.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 2
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 2

blocks.zh: 您的無菌灌填線有20個氣動閥，其排氣口朝向Class B區。根據ISPE和EU GMP Annex 1，您應如何設計採樣計畫？採樣點應設在哪裡？
blocks.en: Your aseptic filling line has 20 pneumatic valves whose exhaust ports face a grade B area. According to ISPE and EU GMP Annex 1, how should you design the sampling plan? Where should the sampling points be located?

blocks.zh: P&ID圖面上的採樣點標識為何重要？若採樣點只有現場標籤而沒有P&ID記錄，會有什麼GMP問題？
blocks.en: Why is the identification of sampling points on the P&ID important? If a sampling point has only a field label and no P&ID record, what GMP problems arise?

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣採樣位置邏輯圖
blocks.en: Compressed Air Sampling Location Logic Diagram

blocks.zh: 系統流程與採樣點對應
blocks.en: System Flow and Corresponding Sampling Points

blocks.zh: 典型藥廠壓縮空氣系統採樣邏輯（從上游到下游）：
blocks.en: Sampling logic for a typical pharmaceutical plant compressed air system (from upstream to downstream):

blocks.zh: 比喻：水管系統的同樣邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The Same Logic as a Water System

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣採樣邏輯如同WFI取樣——從水源頭（壓縮機）到最遠端使用點，確認整個分配系統沒有污染累積。最遠端代表「最糟情況」，因為水分和微生物最可能在長管路中累積。
blocks.en: Compressed air sampling logic is like WFI sampling: from the source (the compressor) to the farthest point of use, you confirm that no contamination accumulates in the distribution system. The farthest point represents the "worst case", because moisture and microorganisms are most likely to accumulate in long pipe runs.

blocks.zh: 鋼瓶供氣系統的簡化管理邏輯
blocks.en: Simplified Management Logic for Cylinder Gas Supply Systems

blocks.zh: CDMO中鋼瓶N₂管理實例
blocks.en: Example of Cylinder N₂ Management at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 許多CDMO的N₂來自外部供應商提供的液態N₂儲槽或高壓鋼瓶。管理重點：
blocks.en: At many CDMOs, N₂ comes from liquid N₂ storage tanks or high-pressure cylinders supplied by external vendors. Management priorities:

blocks.zh: 供應商資格確認（Vendor Qualification）：供應商需提供CoA，且CDMO應有定期稽核計畫
blocks.en: Vendor Qualification: the vendor must provide a CoA, and the CDMO should have a periodic audit program

blocks.zh: 入廠檢驗（Incoming Inspection）：每批N₂的CoA審查是否涵蓋所有規格要求
blocks.en: Incoming Inspection: for each N₂ delivery, review whether the CoA covers all specification requirements

blocks.zh: 分配系統採樣：雖然鋼瓶N₂品質由供應商保證，分配管路（特別是最遠端使用點）仍需定期確認，防止管路污染
blocks.en: Distribution system sampling: although the quality of cylinder N₂ is guaranteed by the vendor, the distribution piping (especially the farthest point of use) still needs periodic confirmation to prevent contamination from the piping

blocks.zh: POU過濾器：無菌充填線上的N₂使用點應裝有0.22μm除菌過濾器，並有更換頻率要求
blocks.en: POU filters: N₂ points of use on the aseptic filling line should be fitted with 0.22 μm sterilizing filters, with a defined replacement frequency

blocks.zh: 思考練習 3
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 3

blocks.zh: CDMO從外部供應商採購液態N₂，用於無菌灌填的瓶頭覆蓋（vial headspace overlay）。請列出您的品質管控採樣計畫：採樣頻率、採樣位置、測試項目各為何？
blocks.en: A CDMO buys liquid N₂ from an external supplier for vial headspace overlay in aseptic filling. List your quality control sampling plan: what are the sampling frequency, sampling locations and test parameters?

blocks.zh: 液態N₂儲槽（on-site bulk storage）與高壓鋼瓶系統在採樣計畫上有哪些不同？
blocks.en: How do the sampling plans differ between an on-site bulk liquid N₂ storage tank and a high-pressure cylinder system?

blocks.zh: Sampling Plan: Tests, Frequency, and Duration | 採樣計畫：測試項目、頻率與期間
blocks.en: Sampling Plan: Tests, Frequency, and Duration

blocks.zh: 監測頻率應對應潔淨室等級
blocks.en: Monitoring Frequency Should Match the Cleanroom Grade

blocks.zh: ISPE的重要原則：進入潔淨室的製程氣體，其監測頻率應與該潔淨室的環境監測頻率一致。例如：
blocks.en: An important ISPE principle: the monitoring frequency for process gases entering a cleanroom should be consistent with the environmental monitoring frequency of that cleanroom. For example:

blocks.zh: Grade A區（灌填區）：進入Grade A的N₂/壓縮空氣應有最高頻率的監測
blocks.en: Grade A area (filling zone): N₂/compressed air entering grade A should have the highest monitoring frequency

blocks.zh: Grade B區：對應EU GMP Annex 1 Grade B的監測頻率
blocks.en: Grade B area: corresponds to the EU GMP Annex 1 grade B monitoring frequency

blocks.zh: Grade C/D：可採用較低頻率，但仍需有計畫
blocks.en: Grade C/D: a lower frequency may be used, but a plan is still required

blocks.zh: 風險分析決定採樣策略
blocks.en: Risk Analysis Determines the Sampling Strategy

blocks.zh: 低露點（低水分）是天然的微生物抑制因素——壓縮空氣系統設計為極度乾燥（典型露點≤ -40°C），微生物難以在此環境存活。這是風險分析可能支持降低微生物測試頻率的科學依據，但不能以此完全取消微生物採樣。
blocks.en: Low dew point (low moisture) is a natural inhibitor of microbial growth: compressed air systems are designed to be extremely dry (typical dew point ≤ -40°C), and microorganisms struggle to survive in such an environment. This is the scientific basis on which a risk analysis may support reducing the frequency of microbial testing, but it cannot be used to eliminate microbial sampling entirely.

blocks.zh: 生命週期分階段採樣要求
blocks.en: Lifecycle-Phased Sampling Requirements

blocks.zh: 思考練習 4
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 4

blocks.zh: 您的壓縮空氣系統完成PQ後，例行監測計畫中露點為何採用「連續監測」而非「定期採樣」？連續監測的儀器需要滿足什麼GMP要求（校正、警報設定）？
blocks.en: After your compressed air system completes PQ, why is the dew point under the routine monitoring plan monitored "continuously" rather than by "periodic sampling"? What GMP requirements (calibration, alarm setting) must the continuous monitoring instrument meet?

blocks.zh: 油含量測試為何只需「年度」執行，而微生物和顆粒需要「季度」？風險論據是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does oil content testing need to be performed only "annually", while microbial and particulate testing is performed "quarterly"? What is the risk rationale?

blocks.zh: 若您的壓縮空氣系統更換了主壓縮機（主要系統修改），根據4.3.3.3，應採取哪些再確認採樣措施？
blocks.en: If your compressed air system has its main compressor replaced (a major system modification), what re-confirmation sampling measures should be taken according to 4.3.3.3?

blocks.zh: Sample Valve Design | 採樣閥設計
blocks.en: Sample Valve Design

blocks.zh: 隔膜閥的衛生設計優勢
blocks.en: Hygienic Design Advantages of Diaphragm Valves

blocks.zh: 在潔淨系統（clean utilities）中，隔膜閥是標準選擇，原因：
blocks.en: In clean utilities, diaphragm valves are the standard choice, because:

blocks.zh: 無死角（zero dead leg）：閥體設計確保流體無滯留
blocks.en: No dead legs (zero dead leg): the valve body design ensures no fluid is retained

blocks.zh: 隔膜材質（通常PTFE/EPDM）不會污染氣體
blocks.en: The diaphragm material (usually PTFE/EPDM) does not contaminate the gas

blocks.zh: 可進行原位（in-situ）蒸汽滅菌或CIP清洗
blocks.en: They can be steam sterilized or CIP cleaned in situ

blocks.zh: 相比球閥，顆粒脫落風險顯著降低
blocks.en: Compared with ball valves, the risk of particle shedding is significantly lower

blocks.zh: 比喻：WFI取樣閥的同樣邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The Same Logic as WFI Sample Valves

blocks.zh: 製程氣體的POU採樣閥設計邏輯與WFI取樣站相同：兩者都使用衛生級隔膜閥，都要求最小化死角，POU的取樣閥（或採樣連接點）都需要有防污染措施（如保護帽、定期滅菌）。
blocks.en: The design logic of POU sample valves for process gases is the same as for WFI sampling stations: both use hygienic diaphragm valves, both require minimal dead legs, and the POU sample valve (or sampling connection) needs contamination protection (such as protective caps or periodic sterilization).

blocks.zh: 思考練習 5
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 5

blocks.zh: 您的無菌灌填線N₂管路在使用點附近需要安裝採樣閥。請指定：閥型、材質、安裝要求、以及如何保持採樣閥本身的無菌性。
blocks.en: Your aseptic filling line N₂ piping requires a sample valve near the point of use. Specify the valve type, material, installation requirements, and how to maintain the sterility of the sample valve itself.

blocks.zh: 如果POU採樣閥的外殼（housing）無法被滅菌，應如何補救，或採取什麼替代措施？
blocks.en: If the housing of a POU sample valve cannot be sterilized, how should this be remediated, or what alternative measures should be taken?

blocks.zh: Sampling Techniques for Compressed Air and Process Gases | 採樣技術
blocks.en: Sampling Techniques for Compressed Air and Process Gases

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 顆粒採樣技術
blocks.en: Commentary — Particle Sampling Techniques

blocks.zh: 「採樣連接」本身是污染風險
blocks.en: The "Sampling Connection" Itself Is a Contamination Risk

blocks.zh: 這是氣體採樣最常被忽視的問題：連接採樣儀器的管路、接頭、閥門本身就可能是顆粒來源。ISPE明確規定：不得使用黃銅或銅製接頭。在CDMO稽核中，若發現採樣連接使用非衛生級材質，可能被標記為缺失。
blocks.en: This is the most commonly overlooked issue in gas sampling: the tubing, fittings and valves used to connect the sampling instrument can themselves be a source of particles. ISPE explicitly states that brass or copper fittings must not be used. In a CDMO audit, the use of non-hygienic materials for sampling connections may be cited as a deficiency.

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣顆粒採樣實務注意事項
blocks.en: Practical Considerations for Compressed Air Particle Sampling

blocks.zh: 取樣前排氣（purging）：採樣前需先排放足量氣體（通常1-5分鐘），確保管路中的靜置氣體被替換
blocks.en: Purging before sampling: purge a sufficient volume of gas before sampling (typically 1-5 minutes) to ensure the stagnant gas in the line is replaced

blocks.zh: 流量控制：高壓氣體需通過壓力調節器降壓至儀器要求壓力（通常大氣壓），過程中調節器本身可能脫落顆粒
blocks.en: Flow control: high-pressure gas must be reduced through a pressure regulator to the pressure the instrument requires (usually atmospheric pressure); the regulator itself may shed particles in the process

blocks.zh: 校正記錄：顆粒計數器需在有效校正期內，且有可追溯的校正記錄
blocks.en: Calibration records: the particle counter must be within its valid calibration period, with traceable calibration records

blocks.zh: 微生物採樣方法比較
blocks.en: Comparison of Microbial Sampling Methods

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 對RTM的立場
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) Position on RTM

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 第9.31條承認即時微生物監測技術，並鼓勵在Grade A環境中使用。對於直接進入Grade A的製程氣體，若採用RTM技術進行連續監測，應有充分的方法驗證（method validation）支持，並建立警戒限和行動限。
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), clause 9.31, recognizes real-time microbial monitoring technologies and encourages their use in grade A environments. For process gases entering grade A directly, if RTM technology is used for continuous monitoring, it should be supported by adequate method validation, with alert and action limits established.

blocks.zh: 水分/露點測試方法與CDMO實務
blocks.en: Moisture/Dew Point Test Methods and CDMO Practice

blocks.zh: 露點與ppm的換算概念
blocks.en: Concept of Converting Dew Point to ppm

blocks.zh: 露點（dew point）是水分含量的間接表達：
blocks.en: Dew point is an indirect expression of moisture content:

blocks.zh: 露點 -46°C = 67 ppm（EP/USP藥典要求下限）
blocks.en: Dew point -46°C = 67 ppm (lower limit required by the EP/USP pharmacopeias)

blocks.zh: 露點 -40°C ≈ 128 ppm
blocks.en: Dew point -40°C ≈ 128 ppm

blocks.zh: 露點 -70°C ≈ 2.6 ppm（ISO 8573-1 Class 1, 最高品質等級）
blocks.en: Dew point -70°C ≈ 2.6 ppm (ISO 8573-1 Class 1, the highest quality class)

blocks.zh: CDMO無菌灌填線上，進入Grade A的N₂/壓縮空氣通常要求露點 ≤ -40°C 至 -70°C，依產品要求而定。
blocks.en: On a CDMO aseptic filling line, N₂/compressed air entering grade A typically requires a dew point ≤ -40°C to -70°C, depending on product requirements.

blocks.zh: 採樣管材料對露點測量的影響
blocks.en: Effect of Sampling Tubing Material on Dew Point Measurement

blocks.zh: ISO 8573-3明確指出PVC、尼龍、橡膠管因會吸附水分，導致測量值偏高（顯示比實際更乾燥，或在乾燥後持續釋放水分）。無菌製藥工廠應使用電解拋光不鏽鋼管或Teflon管（露點>-20°C時）連接露點儀，並確保管路盡可能短，消除死角。
blocks.en: ISO 8573-3 explicitly states that PVC, nylon and rubber tubing adsorb moisture, which distorts the measured value (it reads drier than reality, or continues to release moisture after drying). Sterile pharmaceutical plants should use electropolished stainless steel tubing or Teflon tubing (when the dew point is >-20°C) to connect the dew point meter, and keep the tubing as short as possible with no dead legs.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 6
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 6

blocks.zh: 您的壓縮空氣系統規格要求露點≤ -46°C（67 ppm）。您選擇了阻抗式露點儀進行在線監測，並設置了警戒限-40°C和行動限-35°C。有什麼GMP文件要求需要完成（校正、警報驗證、超限處理流程）？
blocks.en: Your compressed air system specification requires a dew point ≤ -46°C (67 ppm). You selected an impedance-type dew point meter for online monitoring and set an alert limit of -40°C and an action limit of -35°C. What GMP documentation requirements need to be completed (calibration, alarm verification, out-of-limit handling procedure)?

blocks.zh: 進行手動露點採樣時，如果採樣管使用了PVC管，對結果有什麼系統性影響？這屬於哪種類型的測量誤差？
blocks.en: When performing manual dew point sampling, what systematic effect does using PVC tubing have on the results? What type of measurement error is this?

blocks.zh: 油含量測試：氣溶膠 vs. 油蒸氣
blocks.en: Oil Content Testing: Aerosol vs. Oil Vapor

blocks.zh: 無油壓縮機不等於零油污染風險
blocks.en: An Oil-Free Compressor Does Not Mean Zero Oil Contamination Risk

blocks.zh: 即使使用「無油壓縮機」（oil-free compressor），系統中仍可能存在烴類污染的來源：
blocks.en: Even with an "oil-free compressor", sources of hydrocarbon contamination may still exist in the system:

blocks.zh: 壓縮機軸承的潤滑油（雖然不直接接觸氣體，但可能通過密封件滲漏）
blocks.en: Lubricating oil for the compressor bearings (not in direct contact with the gas, but it may leak through seals)

blocks.zh: 管路中的殘留切削油（系統建造時引入）
blocks.en: Residual cutting oil in the piping (introduced during system construction)

blocks.zh: 橡膠密封件老化釋放的塑化劑
blocks.en: Plasticizers released by aging rubber seals

blocks.zh: 潤滑劑用於閥門維護後殘留
blocks.en: Residual lubricant after valve maintenance

blocks.zh: 因此，即使系統設計為無油，仍需有年度油含量驗證計畫。
blocks.en: Therefore, even if the system is designed to be oil-free, an annual oil content verification program is still needed.

blocks.zh: 思考練習 7
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 7

blocks.zh: 您的無菌灌填廠使用無油螺桿式壓縮機，已安裝合流過濾器。根據ISPE建議，油含量測試頻率應為何？若年度測試結果顯示油含量上升趨勢，應採取什麼措施？
blocks.en: Your aseptic filling plant uses an oil-free screw compressor and has installed coalescing filters. According to ISPE recommendations, what should the oil content testing frequency be? If annual test results show a rising trend in oil content, what action should be taken?

blocks.zh: 如果壓縮空氣管路中發現可見油液（visible oil liquid），根據GMP，您的立即行動計畫應包含哪些步驟？哪些批次可能需要召回評估？
blocks.en: If visible oil liquid is found in the compressed air piping, what steps should your immediate action plan include under GMP? Which batches may require recall assessment?

blocks.zh: Sample Handling | 樣品處置
blocks.en: Sample Handling

blocks.zh: 氣體樣品的特殊性
blocks.en: Special Characteristics of Gas Samples

blocks.zh: 製程氣體採樣的樣品處置與液體樣品有根本不同：
blocks.en: Sample handling for process gas sampling is fundamentally different from that for liquid samples:

blocks.zh: 微生物樣品（培養基板/膜）：採樣後需立即移送溫控培養；暴露於環境的時間需記錄在案；從採樣到培養箱的時間不超過4小時（遵循一般環境監測規範）
blocks.en: Microbial samples (culture media plates/membranes): after sampling, transfer immediately to temperature-controlled incubation; the time of exposure to the environment must be recorded; the time from sampling to the incubator should not exceed 4 hours (following general environmental monitoring practice)

blocks.zh: 露點測量：通常為即時讀數，無需「保存」樣品，但儀器記錄需歸檔
blocks.en: Dew point measurement: usually a real-time reading, so no sample needs to be "preserved", but the instrument records must be archived

blocks.zh: 油含量（重量法濾膜）：採樣後需密封保存，避免環境油蒸氣污染，盡快分析
blocks.en: Oil content (gravimetric filter membrane): after sampling, seal and store to avoid contamination by ambient oil vapor, and analyze as soon as possible

blocks.zh: 偵測管（detector tubes）：採樣後立即讀數，不可保存後再讀
blocks.en: Detector tubes: read immediately after sampling; they cannot be stored and read later

blocks.zh: CDMO採樣標籤的GMP要求
blocks.en: GMP Requirements for CDMO Sample Labels

blocks.zh: ISPE列出的標籤資訊對CDMO的採樣SOP具有直接指引意義：
blocks.en: The label information listed by ISPE gives direct guidance for a CDMO's sampling SOP:

blocks.zh: 採樣參數記錄：流量、壓力、溫度、採樣時間——這些是結果有效性的關鍵參數，必須記錄在原始數據表中
blocks.en: Sampling parameter records: flow rate, pressure, temperature, sampling time — these are critical parameters for the validity of the result and must be recorded in the raw data sheet

blocks.zh: 樣品識別碼：與P&ID採樣點標識對應，確保結果可追溯到具體位置
blocks.en: Sample identification code: corresponds to the P&ID sampling point identification, ensuring results are traceable to a specific location

blocks.zh: 採樣人員簽名：21 CFR Part 11 或 EU GMP Annex 11 電子記錄要求適用
blocks.en: Sampler's signature: the electronic record requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 or EU GMP Annex 11 apply

blocks.zh: 送外部實驗室的保管鏈（Chain of Custody）
blocks.en: Chain of Custody for Samples Sent to External Laboratories

blocks.zh: 雖然ISPE表示保管鏈「建議但非強制」，但對CDMO而言，如果氣體樣品（尤其是微生物樣品）的測試結果將用於批次放行決策，建議建立完整的保管鏈文件：
blocks.en: Although ISPE states that chain of custody is "recommended but not mandatory", for a CDMO, if the test results of gas samples (especially microbial samples) will be used for batch release decisions, it is advisable to establish complete chain of custody documentation:

blocks.zh: 採樣交接記錄（手寫或電子）
blocks.en: Sample handover records (handwritten or electronic)

blocks.zh: 運輸條件記錄（溫度、時間）
blocks.en: Transport condition records (temperature, time)

blocks.zh: 外部實驗室接收確認
blocks.en: External laboratory receipt confirmation

blocks.zh: 結果報告回傳記錄
blocks.en: Result report return records

blocks.zh: 思考練習 8
blocks.en: Discussion Exercise 8

blocks.zh: 您的CDMO每季對N₂管路進行微生物採樣（RCS採樣器，培養基盤），採樣後需送至廠內QC微生物實驗室。請設計從採樣到報告的完整樣品處置流程，包括標籤、保存條件、時間限制、以及偏差觸發條件。
blocks.en: Your CDMO performs quarterly microbial sampling of the N₂ piping (RCS sampler, culture media plates), and the samples must be sent to the in-house QC microbiology laboratory. Design the complete sample handling process from sampling to reporting, including labeling, storage conditions, time limits and deviation trigger conditions.

blocks.zh: 若採樣標籤上缺少「採樣流量」這一欄位，這個結果還能用於批次放行判定嗎？請用GMP的角度論述。
blocks.en: If the "sampling flow rate" field is missing from the sample label, can the result still be used for batch release decisions? Argue from a GMP perspective.

blocks.zh: 根據本章整體內容，哪一個CQA測試在CDMO無菌灌填中最容易被忽略，且後果最嚴重？請說明理由。
blocks.en: Based on the whole chapter, which CQA test is most easily overlooked in CDMO aseptic filling and has the most serious consequences? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: Chapter 4 Summary: Test Method Comparison Table | 第四章綜合比較表
blocks.en: Chapter 4 Summary: Test Method Comparison Table

blocks.zh: Chapter 4 Key Messages | 核心要點總結
blocks.en: Chapter 4 Key Messages

blocks.zh: 核心要點（CDMO視角）
blocks.en: Key Points (CDMO Perspective)

blocks.zh: 氣體品質 = 環境品質：所有與無菌產品直接接觸的製程氣體，其微生物和顆粒品質必須等同或優於其所進入的潔淨室環境。這是FDA（2004）和EU GMP Annex 1（2022）的明確法規要求，不是建議。
blocks.en: Gas quality = environmental quality: the microbial and particulate quality of all process gases in direct contact with sterile product must be equal to or better than the cleanroom environment they enter. This is an explicit regulatory requirement of the FDA (2004) and EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), not a recommendation.

blocks.zh: 風險分析主導一切：採樣頻率、測試範圍、採樣位置都必須基於對特定氣體使用場景的風險分析，不可照搬通用程序。
blocks.en: Risk analysis drives everything: sampling frequency, test scope and sampling locations must all be based on a risk analysis of the specific gas use scenario; generic procedures must not be copied wholesale.

blocks.zh: QC vs 製程管控採樣點：兩類採樣點必須在P&ID和SOP中明確區分。QC採樣點的超限結果需啟動偏差調查；製程管控採樣點的結果僅用於系統診斷。
blocks.en: QC vs. process control sampling points: the two types of sampling points must be clearly distinguished on the P&ID and in SOPs. Out-of-limit results at QC sampling points require a deviation investigation; results from process control sampling points are used only for system diagnostics.

blocks.zh: POU採樣位置原則：有POU除菌過濾器的管路，採樣點設在過濾器前方——既評估進入過濾器的氣體品質，又避免在無菌屏障下游設置採樣閥帶來污染風險。
blocks.en: POU sampling location principle: for lines with a POU sterilizing filter, the sampling point is located upstream of the filter, which both evaluates the quality of the gas entering the filter and avoids the contamination risk of a sample valve downstream of the sterile barrier.

blocks.zh: 按CQA差異設定頻率：露點=連續監測；NVP/VP=季度；油含量=年度。頻率可依風險分析和歷史數據調整，但需要有書面論述支持。
blocks.en: Set frequency by CQA: dew point = continuous monitoring; NVP/VP = quarterly; oil content = annual. Frequencies may be adjusted based on risk analysis and historical data, but this must be supported by a written rationale.

blocks.zh: 採樣連接本身是風險：連接採樣儀器的管路、接頭、調節器可能引入顆粒或水分。CDMO應在採樣SOP中規定採樣連接材質、長度和清潔要求。
blocks.en: The sampling connection itself is a risk: the tubing, fittings and regulators connecting the sampling instrument can introduce particles or moisture. The CDMO should specify the material, length and cleaning requirements of the sampling connection in the sampling SOP.

blocks.zh: CDMO差距分析（Gap Analysis）
blocks.en: CDMO Gap Analysis

blocks.zh: 常見的製程氣體品質管理缺失：
blocks.en: Common deficiencies in process gas quality management:

blocks.zh: 壓縮空氣無微生物採樣計畫，僅有油含量和顆粒測試
blocks.en: No microbial sampling plan for compressed air, only oil content and particle testing

blocks.zh: N₂覆蓋無菌產品，但N₂管路在P&ID上沒有QC採樣點標識
blocks.en: N₂ is used to overlay sterile product, but the N₂ piping has no QC sampling point identified on the P&ID

blocks.zh: POU除菌過濾器沒有更換頻率要求，或未有完整的更換記錄
blocks.en: POU sterilizing filters have no replacement frequency requirement, or lack complete replacement records

blocks.zh: 露點儀無校正計畫，或警報設定點未經驗證
blocks.en: Dew point meters have no calibration program, or alarm set points have not been verified

blocks.zh: 氣動閥排氣方向未在設計中考量（排入Class B/A區空間）
blocks.en: Pneumatic valve exhaust direction was not considered in the design (exhausting into the grade B/A area space)
